scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @beyondx/api && npm run build -w @beyondx/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @beyondx/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @beyondx/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @beyondx/api && npm run typecheck -w @beyondx/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @beyondx/shared && npm run test -w @beyondx/api
